What PMEX does

Built to remove the friction from every stage of your revenue cycle

Replace manual billing tasks

Manual billing processes slow down teams and increase the risk of costly errors. PMEX automates key steps across the revenue cycle, from claim validation to submission and tracking, reducing the need for repetitive administrative work.

Reduce denials before they happen

PMEX flags high-risk claims before submission, using payer-specific rules and denial pattern analysis to stop preventable denials at the source.

See your revenue clearly

Real-time dashboards give you full visibility into collections, denials, and AR trends across every payer and site, so you always know where revenue stands.

Respond to issues instantly

Get alerted the moment an issue arises, from a stalled claim to a payer policy change, so your team can act immediately instead of finding out weeks later.
